handoff.salientSummary: Verified API key security throughout the system. Keys are stored only in K8s Secrets with base64 encoding, mounted securely as read-only volumes to Job pods, never exposed in API responses or DB records, and never logged.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Verified existing secret security implementation: K8s Secret manager creates base64-encoded API keys; Keys mounted as read-only volumes to Job pods at /etc/api-keys; Config files use env:// reference instead of actual keys; Model API responses never contain actual keys (only static lists); DB stores only api_key_ref reference, not actual keys.

commandsRun.observation: All packages pass: cache, evaluator, handler, k8s, configmap, job, secret, monitor, repository, service

tests.coverage: All existing tests pass. Secret manager has 20+ test cases, Job creator has 15+ test cases covering Secret volume mounting.
